actions.description: Apply durable fenced promotion and proxy switch
actions.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import os, tempfile

STATE = "/var/lib/failover"

def atomic_write(path, content):
    """Write content to path atomically with fsync of file and parent dir."""
    d = os.path.dirname(path)
    fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=d, prefix=".tmp.")
    try:
        os.write(fd, content)
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    os.replace(tmp, path)
    # fsync the directory so the rename/create is durable
    dirfd = os.open(d, os.O_RDONLY|os.O_DIRECTORY)
    try:
        os.fsync(dirfd)
    finally:
        os.close(dirfd)
